versions.changelog:
Initial release of Desktop Organizer skill:

- Automatically organizes desktop files by extension into categorized folders (PDFs, Images, Archives, Documents, Presentations).
- Supports common file types: PDFs, images (JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF), archives (ZIP, RAR, 7z), Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.
- Creates destination folders if they do not exist.
- Prevents moving open, locked, system, or shortcut files.
- Reports the number and types of files organized after completion.
